sections.title: Scenario events
sections.note: Meet her at this place and time to start the scene; talking costs 1 Heart Clock. Bond choices: +25 small, +50 medium, +100 big. Some days have different scenes depending on her Connection level. "Unlimited" scenes repeat after day 21.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the bamboo forest.

rows.text: You shouldn't put that much pressure on yourself.
What type of food do you usually prefer?

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the walking trail.

rows.text: Everything was so delicious that it was hard to choose.
The apple pie, naturally.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the bamboo forest.

rows.text: Why do you ask?
I always have time for you.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the waterfall.

rows.text: One so extravagant that it lights up the entire night sky.
Something nice and simple, which illuminates the area around it.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the bamboo forest.

rows.text: What? That's not what I was getting at.
Well... of course that's something I've been looking forward to.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the restaurant.

rows.text: I take a spoonful of the rice and hand it to Ludmilla.
Grabbing a spoon, I take a spoonful of the rice bowl and chow down.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla in the dormitory.

rows.text: I could say the same thing to you.
I get a lot of enjoyment out of talking to you.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla in the dormitory.

rows.text: Whose diary?
I can't put my finger on it, but that thing creeps me out.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the walking trail.

rows.text: I had a wonderful time, thanks to you.
I had a wonderful time being around everyone.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the walking trail.

rows.text: Do you see something?
I don't see her.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla in the dormitory.

rows.text: I'll help Mica.
I'll help you with the lanterns.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the bamboo forest.

rows.text: She left a note, so I'm sure she's fine.
Before the sun sets, let's look around a bit more.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the walking trail.

rows.text: Has this happened to you?
Yes. If someone asks me for help, I do whatever I can, no questions asked.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the bamboo forest.

rows.text: Lavender sounds nice.
Jasmine sounds nice.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla in the dormitory.

rows.text: If you leave it in the restaurant, I'm sure someone who's hungry will eat it.
Grab a spoon, take a spoonful of the donburi and chow down.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the walking trail.

rows.text: You were able to toss the coin inside the basket, so everything will be fine.
Do you want to head back to the hot spring?

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the bamboo forest.

rows.text: I just don't want legends of the past to tie us down.
I think those legends have given us some indelible experiences here at Snowfield.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla in the dormitory.

rows.text: I'll notify Signal.
I'll try contacting the higher-ups later.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the walking trail.

rows.text: Is there really a legendary fish...
So people have been having the same reaction to this waterfall for a while.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the walking trail.

rows.text: I did invite them out all this way, so I'm a bit nervous that everything won't be perfect.
I'm sure they'll have a wonderful time here.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the walking trail.

rows.text: Stay quiet.
Hold Ludmilla's hand.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla in the dormitory.

rows.text: Should we leave so that Anne can get some more sleep?
You're the consummate host, Ludmilla.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the bamboo forest.

rows.text: Perhaps, but isn't a bit of silence better?
A bit of noise isn't always a bad thing.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the restaurant.

rows.text: I'm leaning towards the eerie stories.
I'm leaning towards the adventure stories.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the walking trail.

rows.text: I'm sure the same could be said for other places.
Do you think that there's a hidden story behind every beautiful place?

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the walking trail.

rows.text: Well, I hope whatever she wishes for comes true.
Well, I hope that she can live a happy life going forward.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the bamboo forest.

rows.text: That's too bad, but I understand. Besides, we'll have many more walks together in the future.
If you're quick about it, we can still enjoy our walk together. I can help as well.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla in the dormitory.

rows.text: Isn't it a bit odd to find everyday life so fascinating?
That's understandable. Some people can find that sort of quotidian routine intriguing.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the bamboo forest.

rows.text: That would seem to indicate...
Yes, but maybe the wish can still come true.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the bamboo forest.

rows.text: She was?
Are you sure it was her?

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the bamboo forest.

rows.text: This all happened because you spoke to her first.
You would have done the same thing.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla in the dormitory.

rows.text: I came here because I wanted to look at the books I haven't read yet.
I came here because I wanted to share one last cup of tea with you.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the hot spring.

rows.text: I just wanted to look around one last time.
I was looking for you.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the walking trail.

rows.text: I came since I wanted to see you.
I wanted to take a walk.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the bamboo forest.

rows.text: I came since I missed those walks with your company.
I wanted to take a walk.

rows.label: I find Ludmilla at the waterfall.

rows.text: I wanted to see the night sky.
I was on a walk and just dropped by.

sections.title: Ludmilla's mood by level
sections.note: The diary line shown at each Connection level.
items: She seems more interested in the legend of the walking trail now.
She seems to be bothered by something.
She smiles whenever she looks at the bamboo forest.
She's pleased that the tea leaves she designated carefully have been delivered.
She is thinking about the fear in Lumi's eyes.
She smiles as she imagines the days filled with new wishes.
The fragrance of the flowers from that day will never disappear from her memory.
